title: Cargo Shorts 3-Pack – Relaxed Men's Shorts with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Three pairs of comfortable shorts – ready for summer

Good everyday shorts quickly run out in the closet. Finding a pair that both fits well and can take a bit more is harder than you'd think.

Hard-wearing fabric with plenty of pockets

These cargo shorts come in a 3-pack and are made in a hard-wearing, textured fabric. The roomy pockets make them both practical and comfortable for everyday wear and outdoor life.

Features

  • 3 pairs in one purchase
  • Hard-wearing, textured fabric
  • Several roomy pockets
  • Relaxed fit
  • Perfect for summer and everyday

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
